title: Iligan ESG Indicator Record
description: Canonical shape for every indicator data point in the Iligan El Nino ESG Resilience Dashboard, per CLAUDE.md. One record = one indicator reading for one barangay at one point in time.

date_time.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the observation/report. Display converts to Asia/Manila (UTC+8).

barangay.description: One of Iligan City's 44 barangays. Must match a name in data/barangays.json.

latitude.description: Decimal degrees. Null if no citable coordinate exists yet — never estimate.

longitude.description: Decimal degrees. Null if no citable coordinate exists yet — never estimate.

value.description: Null if unknown/pending. Numeric for measured quantities; string for status-type indicators (e.g. government_response_status).

unit.description: Null only when value is null.

band.description: Required alongside the numeric value whenever indicator is heat_index — CLAUDE.md requires the band name always be shown, not just the number. Null/omitted for other indicators.

source.description: Where this value came from, e.g. 'PAGASA iHeatMAP', 'Open-Meteo (supplementary)', 'City DRRMO situation report'. Null only while pending.

responsible_office.description: The city/national office that owns this data, e.g. 'PAGASA', 'City DRRMO', 'City Agriculture Office'. Null only while the owner is unconfirmed.

status.description: verified = confirmed against an authoritative source; reported = as given by the owning office, unverified; estimated = official estimate; derived = calculated by this project (must also carry the 'Derived DEVCON Iligan indicator' label in the UI).

remarks.description: Free text for caveats, provenance notes, or 'NO DATA / PENDING' context. Null if nothing to add.
